title: A while loop stops the instant its condition becomes false
statement: The condition of a while loop is watched continuously, so the loop exits in the middle of the body the moment the condition turns false.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: trace a while loop whose condition becomes false partway through the body
evidence_patterns.signature: stops the trace before the rest of the body runs on the final iteration

example.item:
i = 0
while i < 2:
    i = i + 1
    print(i)

discriminators.vs_slip: Consistent across items, especially when the update comes before other statements in the body. A slip is a single dropped line.

vs.prog.control.if-is-loop: Different statement; test each with its own item.

conflicts_with.label: A loop checks its condition only at defined points and repeats its whole body

resolved_by.label: A loop checks its condition only at defined points and repeats its whole body
Statements run one at a time in order

sources.citation: Pea, R. D. (1986). Language-independent conceptual "bugs" in novice programming. Journal of Educational Computing Research, 2(1), 25-36.
sources.note: Parallelism bug: several lines believed to be active at once.
